ativ1_desc: On July 3rd, 2026, an introductory Digital Forensics short course will be held covering computational expertise, fundamental concepts, analysis of digital evidence, and practical applications.
ativ2_desc: A gathering of cybersecurity groups featuring a CTF competition took place on April 11th and 12th, 2026.
